nodes.label: SlangService.java (not ported)
nodes.rationale: SlangService.java is commented out in the Java source and has not been ported to Swift yet, indicating the port deliberately leaves this feature incomplete.

nodes.label: UV Index Advice Feature
nodes.rationale: UV advice depends on One Call API 4.0, which requires its own separate OpenWeatherMap subscription beyond the base weather API; the app is designed to degrade gracefully, still showing weather data without UV advice if that subscription is absent.
